mode_a_direct.topology: Cloudflare Ingress (Anycast) -> Direct Origin Dial (No PROXYIP)
mode_a_direct.behavior: Cloudflare Workers outbound TCP connect() to external ports 80/443 without PROXYIP is blocked by Cloudflare V8 isolate sandbox policies.

mode_b_proxyip.behavior: Cloudflare Anycast edge accepts WS upgrade. Egress TCP connection to theecyezvuzkflwikxwr.supabase.co:443 fails because Supabase is an HTTPS/TLS endpoint rather than a raw TCP proxy relay, triggering origin socket reset (WS close 0x8800).

mode_c_socks5.behavior: Requires active upstream authenticated SOCKS5 proxy credentials. Handshake parsed by edgetunnel SOCKS5 state machine and closed without credentials.
